2028 Ford Mustang Cobra For S650 Generation Springs Out From Behind the CGI Curtain Looking Feisty
16 photos
Photo: jlord8 / Instagram
The Ford Motor Company traversed a rather tough spot with the S650 iteration of the iconic Ford Mustang , as it didn’t live up to the sales expectations imposed by the S550 predecessor until now. Alas, in terms of potential, it’s massively ahead.
For starters, you can’t have anything like the Ford Mustang with a V8 straight from the dealership – the General Motors pony car, Chevrolet Camaro, has been retired since late 2023, and Stellantis has also killed off the Challenger, leaving only the Charger to fend for itself. But the latter, based on the new STLA Large architecture, is a bit of a shadow – it comes with EV and inline-six twin-turbo options.
The 2027 Ford Mustang, meanwhile, can be had with an affordable EcoBoost inline-four turbo solution and 315 hp or as the GT with the iconic 5.0-liter Coyote V8. Actually, there’s another naturally-aspirated V8 model – the Dark Horse, which has 500 hp – and a couple of supercharged V8s.
Those are the flagship Mustang GTD, which is basically a GT3 racer for the street, and the new Dark Horse SC coupe and convertible, which also uses the 5.2-liter supercharged Predator V8 under the hood and many racing-proven features to give fans a taste of what has become known as the successor to the iconic Shelby GT500.
Now that’s all fine and dandy, but it seems that Ford isn’t done yet – just recently the rumor mill proudly announced that it caught whispers of the Blue Oval preparing yet another version of the S650 Mustang, or even two. More precisely, it seems that the automaker is prepared to bring back the beloved Cobra and Cobra R nameplates, with both used as intermediate versions tucked between the Dark Horse and Dark Horse R, where there’s plenty of hp space – from 500 to 795 hp is a long way to go, indeed.
If the rumors are correct, then the revived Ford Mustang Cobra and Cobra R will become the spiritual successors to the S550 Shelby GT350 and GT350R. Naturally, that has attracted a lot of attention, including from across the parallel universes of vehicular CGI, where the members of the imaginative guild of digital car content creators have started preparing their latest unofficial, hypothetical design projects based on these rumors – and have come up with brand-new S650 Cobra Rs.
But that’s not all, because Jim, a virtual artist known as " jlord8 " on social media, loves messing around with all things CGI from the automotive realm, and he dreams of a new Cobra – this time around the ‘base’ model instead of the more extreme Cobra R version like his fellow pixel master.
Anyway, the CGI expert has used the Ford Mustang Dark Horse SC as the starting point but reworked the design and the iconic alloy wheels to better fit the Cobra persona. Cool, right? View this post on Instagram A post shared by Jim (@jlord8)
